question: Verisk Analytics (VRSK) Rule 10b5-1 durations & end date rationale.
expected_answer:
The newly adopted Rule 10b5-1 trading plans have the following durations:

• CEO, Lee M. Shavel: February effective date with the first trade scheduled on or after March 15, 2024, and the plan is valid until December 31, 2024.
• CFO, Elizabeth D. Mann: Similarly, with the first trade beginning on or after March 15, 2024 and the plan valid until December 31, 2024.
• Controller/Chief Accounting Officer, David J. Grover: The first trade is set for on or after March 15, 2024 and the plan expires earlier on April 1, 2024.

Regarding the differing end dates – while the CEO and CFO’s plans extend until the end of 2024, the Controller’s plan terminates earlier (April 1, 2024) – the provided data does not supply additional context or information to explain these differences. No significant reasons for this variation are disclosed within the reference; the dates appear to be determined by individual or position-specific trading strategies as permitted under the company’s Insider Trading Policy.
